title: Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Field Standard: Wait at the Address, Redelivery Fee, Attempts and Storage Hold
content:
At every Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery service level the team waits a set number of minutes at the address before recording a failed attempt; a rebooking after a failed attempt caused by the customer carries a redelivery fee; a booking allows a set number of delivery attempts before it is cancelled; and goods are held for a set number of calendar days after a failed attempt awaiting a rebooking.

## Standard by service level

| Service level | Minutes the team waits at the address | Fee to rebook after a failed attempt caused by the customer | Delivery attempts allowed before the booking is cancelled | Calendar days goods are held after a failed attempt |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Delivery | 15 | $39.00 | 2 | 14 |
| Threshold Delivery | 15 | $59.00 | 2 | 14 |
| Room of Choice Delivery | 15 | $79.00 | 2 | 14 |
| White Glove Delivery | 15 | $79.00 | 2 | 14 |
| White Glove Delivery with Assembly | 15 | $79.00 | 2 | 14 |
| Premier White Glove with Haul-Away | 15 | $79.00 | 2 | 14 |

## Notes

- The wait, the number of attempts and the storage hold are the same at all six levels: 15 minutes, 2 attempts and 14 calendar days.
- The redelivery fee is in US dollars to the cent and differs by level: $39.00 at Curbside Delivery, $59.00 at Threshold Delivery and $79.00 at each level from Room of Choice Delivery upward.
- The storage hold is counted in calendar days, so weekend days count toward the 14.
